_: Built by scripts/build_vintage_shops.py from data/things.json (Shopping group: vintage, thrift, consignment, antique and record shops). Walking order. Nothing here is typed by hand; a fact things.json lacks is listed in the shop's gaps. Add or fix a shop in things.json and rebuild.

shops.name: Burlington Records
shops.blurb: Downtown Burlington's independent vinyl shop with an extensive catalog organized by genre and era.

shops.name: Outdoor Gear Exchange
shops.blurb: Church Street's legendary gear shop — new equipment up top, and a consignment section where patient people score serious deals on used outdoor kit.

shops.name: Barge Canal Market
shops.blurb: Pine Street's vintage anchor — mid-century furniture, records, and oddities from many sellers under one roof.

shops.name: Speaking Volumes
shops.blurb: Used books, old maps, and vinyl sharing shelf space on Pine Street — the browse rewards patience and punishes schedules.

shops.name: Junktiques Collective
shops.blurb: North Winooski Avenue's dig-for-it thrift trove — furniture, oddities, and the occasional genuine score priced like nobody checked.

shops.name: Autumn Records
shops.blurb: A Winooski record store run by an internationally recognized experimental musician — the curation reflects that.

shops.name: Five Corners Antiques
shops.blurb: A massive multi-dealer antique depot in Essex, fifteen minutes out — the kind of place you enter curious and exit two hours later carrying a lamp.
